card.fact_statement: China Railways Number 10 was part of the joint venture that contracted the Thailand State Audit Office building.
card.source_span: the contractors were the joint venture between Italian-Thai Development and China Railways Number 10 (Thailand) Co., Ltd.

target_qa_variants.question: ¿Qué empresa con afiliación extranjera formó parte de la empresa conjunta que obtuvo el contrato del edificio de la Oficina de Auditoría del Estado de Tailandia antes de su colapso?
target_qa_variants.source_span: the contractors were the joint venture between Italian-Thai Development and China Railways Number 10 (Thailand) Co., Ltd.
target_qa_variants.translation_note: Company names are kept in their established international (English) forms as they are proper nouns. 'Contracted' is translated as 'obtuvo el contrato' (obtained the contract) for natural phrasing in Spanish.
